evidence_locator: Our 2026 Endorsements; explicit September 8–15 general vote and primary-to-general carry-forward statement; five approved Seattle-intersecting candidate-card changes. Manually preserved visible excerpt.
transcription:
The vote for general election endorsements was conducted from September 8-15, 2026. Any candidate endorsed by the ECC for the primary election remains endorsed for the general election. Candidates noted with an asterix (*) did not advance to the 2026 general election.
U.S. Representative — Congressional District 7: Pramila Jayapal
U.S. Representative — Congressional District 9: Adam Smith
Legislative District 43 State Senator: Jamie Pedersen; Hannah Sabio-Howell
Legislative District 34 State Representative — Position 2: Mary Anito
Legislative District 36 State Representative — Position 1: Julia Grant Reed
